title: the wood
caption: There is a path. It was agreed some time ago, and not by you.

hotspots.label: The gap in the trees, back toward the field
A green glow between the trunks ahead
hotspots.text: You take three steps toward it and it is no nearer. Not yet, then.
hotspots.hint: The clearing. Round, mown, deliberate — someone maintains it. Something is kept at the centre of it. This is the heart of the wood region: build it as a hub with its own doors deeper in.

hotspots.label: Something pale between the far trunks
hotspots.text: When the moment passes it is where it started. You are nearly sure.

hotspots.label: A lantern hanging from a branch
hotspots.text: Lit, briefly. Whoever keeps it does not keep it for you.

hotspots.label: A hole between the roots
hotspots.text: The same tenant as the hole in the field. The grass at the mouth is combed flat in both directions.
